nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Records releases and unreleased changes for Local AI Chat Studio, including features, fixes, and security updates.

nodes.name: CODE_TUTORIAL.md
nodes.summary: Provides a zero-to-hero code tutorial that explains both the retired Streamlit implementation and the current FastAPI and React architecture.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Defines contributor setup, code-style, verification, pull-request, and issue-selection guidance for the project.

nodes.name: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Reports the generated codebase graph, including connected components, community hubs, dependency cycles, and knowledge gaps.

nodes.name: Launch Chat Studio.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that provisions portable uv and Node.js when needed, synchronizes Python and frontend dependencies, builds the frontend, and starts the local FastAPI workspace.
nodes.languageNotes: A batch wrapper extracts and executes an embedded PowerShell payload for robust Windows setup and runtime management.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview covering features, architecture, installation, configuration, usage, verification, and security for the local-first AI chat workspace.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States the project security policy, supported versions, scope, and process for responsibly reporting vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Describes runtime architecture, persistence, sessions, run lifecycles, providers, configuration, and API development boundaries.

nodes.name: USAGE.md
nodes.summary: Guides users through launching the studio, selecting models, managing conversations and memory, and troubleshooting privacy-related issues.

nodes.name: USER_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Explains day-to-day Chat Studio workflows for chat, context, tools, replay, providers, library management, settings, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: ZERO_TO_HERO_STUDY_HANDBOOK.md
nodes.summary: Offers a comprehensive study handbook covering AI foundations, installation, the FastAPI and React workspace, historical modules, traces, testing, and contributor exercises.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines Python package metadata, runtime and development dependencies, the chat-studio CLI entry point, Hatch build settings, and uv package behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 621 project metadata with Hatchling as the build backend and uv-managed dependency groups.

nodes.name: Test-LocalPort
nodes.summary: Checks whether a TCP listener is reachable on the Studio's local port.

nodes.name: Get-PortOwnerIds
nodes.summary: Finds process IDs listening on port 8506, using Windows networking APIs with a netstat fallback.

nodes.name: Clear-LocalPort
nodes.summary: Stops a healthy previous Studio instance or terminates the verified port owner before startup.

nodes.name: Get-FilesFingerprint
nodes.summary: Computes a stable SHA-256 fingerprint over repository-relative build inputs while rejecting paths outside the project root.

nodes.name: Get-FrontendState
nodes.summary: Determines whether frontend dependencies or the Vite build need refreshing from fingerprint or timestamp state.

nodes.name: Install-Node
nodes.summary: Downloads a supported Node.js LTS archive, verifies its official checksum, and installs it into the launcher runtime directory.
